metadata.DisplayName: Llama 3.2 1B Simple Fine Tuning with Lora on GPU, 4K sequence length
metadata.Name: llmft_llama3_2_1b_instruct_seq4k_gpu_sft_lora

dataset_max_len.description: Maximum sequence length in tokens for tokenized training inputs. Sequences longer than this are truncated.
dataset_max_len.hint: Must be a value between 256 and 131072

global_batch_size.description: Total number of training samples processed per optimizer step. Larger values improve training stability but use more memory.
global_batch_size.hint: Choose from the available batch size options

gradient_clipping.description: Boolean flag to enable gradient norm clipping. When enabled, gradients are scaled down if their norm exceeds the threshold, preventing exploding gradients during training.

gradient_clipping_threshold.description: Maximum allowed gradient norm. Gradients exceeding this value are proportionally scaled down.

learning_rate.description: Step size for weight updates during optimization. Controls how much model weights change per gradient step. Set lower for RL (e.g., 1e-5) to avoid policy collapse; higher for SFT/DPO (e.g., 1e-4).
learning_rate.hint: Must be a value between 5e-07 and 0.0001

logging_steps.description: Frequency (in optimizer steps) at which training metrics are logged. A value of 1 logs every step. Higher values reduce logging overhead.

lora_alpha.description: LoRA scaling factor. The effective learning rate for LoRA adapters scales as alpha/rank. Typically set to 2x the LoRA rank.

lora_dropout.description: Dropout probability applied to LoRA adapter layers for regularization. Typically set to 0.05 for SFT/DPO, and 0 for Mixture-of-Experts models.

lora_rank.description: Number of trainable dimensions in the LoRA adapter. Higher values increase model capacity but use more memory.

lr_scheduler.description: Learning rate decay schedule over training. Cosine anneals smoothly from peak to near-zero.

lr_warmup_steps_ratio.description: Fraction of total training steps spent gradually increasing the learning rate from zero. Helps stabilize early training.
lr_warmup_steps_ratio.hint: Must be a value between 0 and 1

max_epochs.description: Number of complete passes through the entire training dataset. More epochs allow the model to learn patterns more thoroughly but increase training time and risk of overfitting.
max_epochs.hint: Must be a value between 1 and 100

merge_weights.description: When enabled, merges LoRA adapter weights into the base model weights after training, producing a single consolidated model. Disable if you need to keep adapters separate (e.g., for model merging workflows).

mlflow_run_id.description: MLflow run ID for resuming or linking to an existing run

mlflow_tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking server URI for experiment logging

model_name_or_path.description: Model identifier or path to pretrained model

name.hint: A training job with the name {name} will be created
name.invalid_format_error: It should be maximum 63 alphanumeric characters and cannot include spaces. It must also be unique within your account in an AWS Region

output_path.description: Local output path for model artifacts

results_directory.description: Directory for storing training results and logs

resume_from_path.description: Path to checkpoint for resuming training

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Controls data shuffling order, weight initialization, and other stochastic operations.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for evaluation and generation. Higher values increase output randomness/diversity; lower values make outputs more deterministic.
temperature.hint: Must be a value between 0.0 and 2.0

train_val_split_ratio.description: Fraction of the dataset allocated to training versus validation. For example, 0.9 means 90% training and 10% validation.
train_val_split_ratio.hint: Must be a value between 0.0 and 1.0

training_data_name.description: Name identifier for the training dataset

validation_data_name.description: Name identifier for the validation dataset

weight_decay.description: L2 regularization coefficient applied to model weights during optimization. Helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large weights.

training_recipe.yaml:
display_name: Llama 3.2 1B Simple Fine Tuning with Lora on GPU, 4K sequence length
elastic_policy:
  graceful_shutdown_timeout: 600
  is_elastic: false
  max_nodes: 16
  min_nodes: 1
  scaling_timeout: 600
  use_graceful_shutdown: true
instance_types:
- ml.p4de.24xlarge
- ml.p4d.24xlarge
- ml.p5.48xlarge
- ml.g5.48xlarge
- ml.g5.12xlarge
- ml.g6.48xlarge
- ml.g6.12xlarge
- ml.g6e.12xlarge
run:
  hf_access_token: null
  model_type: llm_finetuning_aws
  name: '{{name}}'
  results_dir: '{{results_directory}}'
scale_config:
  1:
    trainer:
      num_nodes: 1
    training_config:
      training_args:
        learning_rate: 0.0004
        micro_train_batch_size: 8
        train_batch_size: 128
  2:
    trainer:
      num_nodes: 2
    training_config:
      training_args:
        learning_rate: 0.0004
        micro_train_batch_size: 8
        train_batch_size: 128
  3:
    trainer:
      num_nodes: 3
    training_config:
      training_args:
        learning_rate: 0.0004
        train_batch_size: 128
        uneven_batch:
          large_local_batch_size: 6
          num_dp_groups_with_small_batch_size: 16
          small_local_batch_size: 5
          use_uneven_batch: true
  4:
    trainer:
      num_nodes: 4
    training_config:
      training_args:
        learning_rate: 0.0004
        micro_train_batch_size: 4
        train_batch_size: 128
  6:
    trainer:
      num_nodes: 6
    training_config:
      training_args:
        learning_rate: 0.0004
        train_batch_size: 128
        uneven_batch:
          large_local_batch_size: 3
          num_dp_groups_with_small_batch_size: 16
          small_local_batch_size: 2
          use_uneven_batch: true
  8:
    trainer:
      num_nodes: 8
    training_config:
      training_args:
        learning_rate: 0.0004
        micro_train_batch_size: 2
        train_batch_size: 128
  16:
    trainer:
      num_nodes: 16
    training_config:
      training_args:
        learning_rate: 0.0004
        train_batch_size: 128
trainer:
  devices: 8
  num_nodes: 1
training_config:
  datasets:
    data_dir: null
    preprocessor_cfgs:
    - type: TrainingSFTSampleConverter
    - chat_template_name: llama_3_2_seq_instruct.jinja
      ignore_prompt_labels: true
      type: Seq2SeqTokensProcessor
    - tokens_labels:
      - input_ids
      type: SequenceLengthFilter
    - column_names:
      - messages
      type: DropColumns
    save_intermediate_processing_steps: false
    train_data:
      file_path: '{{data_path}}'
      limit: null
      name: '{{training_data_name}}'
    train_val_split_ratio: '{{train_val_split_ratio}}'
    train_val_split_seed: 42
    val_data:
      file_path: '{{validation_data_path}}'
      limit: null
      name: '{{validation_data_name}}'
  force_rerun: false
  mlflow:
    run_id: '{{mlflow_run_id}}'
    tracking_uri: '{{mlflow_tracking_uri}}'
  model_config:
    apply_chat_template: false
    attn_implementation: sdpa
    chat_template_key: llama--meta-llama-3.2-1b-instruct
    device_map: null
    generation_cfg:
      do_sample: true
      max_new_tokens: 2048
      num_parallel_jobs: 1
      num_return_sequences: 1
      temperature: '{{temperature}}'
      top_p: 0.9
    lora_checkpoint_file_path: '{{resume_from_path}}'
    model_name_or_path: '{{model_name_or_path}}'
    model_save_name: SageMaker/llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-Lora
    multimodal: false
    peft_config:
      bias: none
      lora_alpha: '{{lora_alpha}}'
      lora_dropout: '{{lora_dropout}}'
      peft_type: lora
      r: '{{lora_rank}}'
      target_modules: all-linear
      task_type: CAUSAL_LM
      use_dora: false
  training_args:
    adam_betas:
    - 0.9
    - 0.95
    aux_loss_coef: 0
    disable_ds_ckpt: false
    disable_fast_tokenizer: false
    eval_steps: 0
    grad_accum_dtype: null
    gradient_checkpointing: true
    gradient_checkpointing_use_reentrant: false
    gradient_clipping: '{{gradient_clipping}}'
    gradient_clipping_threshold: '{{gradient_clipping_threshold}}'
    l2: 0.0
    learning_rate: '{{learning_rate}}'
    load_checkpoint: true
    logging_steps: '{{logging_steps}}'
    lr_scheduler: '{{lr_scheduler}}'
    lr_warmup_ratio: '{{lr_warmup_steps_ratio}}'
    max_ckpt_mem: 100000000.0
    max_ckpt_num: 3
    max_epochs: '{{max_epochs}}'
    max_len: '{{dataset_max_len}}'
    max_norm: 1.0
    max_samples: 100000000.0
    merge_weights: '{{merge_weights}}'
    micro_train_batch_size: 1
    override_training_dir: true
    packing_samples: false
    pretrain_mode: false
    resume_checkpoint_path: '{{resume_from_path}}'
    ring_attn_size: 1
    ring_head_stride: 1
    save_hf_ckpt: true
    save_steps: 0
    seed: '{{seed}}'
    strategy:
      fsdp_config:
        auto_wrap_policy: TRANSFORMER_BASED_WRAP
        backward_prefetch: BACKWARD_PRE
        cpu_offload: false
        cpu_ram_efficient_loading: true
        forward_prefetch: false
        sharding_strategy: HYBRID_SHARD
        state_dict_type: SHARDED_STATE_DICT
        sync_module_states: true
        use_orig_params: true
    train_batch_size: '{{global_batch_size}}'
    trainer_callbacks:
    - _target_: metering_callback.MeteringCallback
      output_path: /opt/ml/metering
    trainer_type: sft
    training_dir: '{{output_path}}'
    use_tensorboard: logs
    use_wandb: null
    weight_decay: '{{weight_decay}}'
version: 2.2.4
